verdicts.explanation: The paper computes 10.36 mS/cm for LBPSI from its own MLMD/Nernst-Einstein analysis (Eq. 2), so the origin is computational. No measurement temperature is stated for this conductivity, so null is correct, and the 0.2241 eV activation energy is the paper's own Li+ Arrhenius fit.

The 2.4 mS/cm value is explicitly the experimental value from the cited study (ref. 17), so literature_cited is correct and the temperature is correctly null. The ball-milling synthesis note is stated in the paper for the experimental sample, though the parenthetical provenance text is untidy.
